sections.label: HDB concrete technology improvements
sections.summary: HDB keeps abreast of concrete technology improvements and introduces new materials after testing for performance and cost effectiveness.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: To enhance a building's structural performance, HDB keeps abreast of improvements in concrete technology and introduces new materials after they have been tested for performance and cost effectiveness.

sections.label: Structural health monitoring sensors
sections.summary: About a decade ago, HDB began installing structural health monitoring sensors in key structural columns of new HDB developments.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: About a decade ago, HDB also started installing structural health monitoring sensors in key structural columns of new HDB developments.

sections.label: UEM use and noise modelling
sections.summary: HDB used UEM in Punggol Treelodge planning and design, now uses it wider in Bidadari and Tengah, and uses noise modelling to guide block orientation and barriers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: HDB started using UEM some years back in the planning and design of the Build-To-Order (BTO) development known as Punggol Treelodge, and is now using UEM on a much wider scale in BTO projects in Bidadari and Tengah.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: To mitigate noise impact in buildings, advanced noise modelling is used to guide the orientation of HDB blocks and the placement of physical barriers to enhance aural comfort.
